Austin has officially declared July 13th #SandraBland Day 

#OTD in 2015, Sandra Bland was found dead in her jail cell after being arrested for a traffic violation. The officer claimed to fear for his life, despite Sandra being unarmed. #BlackLivesMatter #SayHerName https://t.co/a3aKQ25Eos

It’s been five years since the police in-custody death of #EricGarner. We must continue to work tirelessly in our pursuit of  #PoliceReform and ensuring the humanity of Black people is recognized. #RestInPower #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/SFeHZ4V5Qj

Michael Brown was a son, a student and he was a friend. Five years later, his death stands as a stark reminder of how much work there is still left to do. #PoliceReform #BlackLivesMatter #RestInPower #OTD https://t.co/NxyhL8Tal9
